sections.title: From compound to certification
sections.live: LIVE H2 → From Compound to Certification · six steps · the same text as all 31 pages

fields.label: Steps
rows: Material compounding — polymer blending, additive integration and batch QC in our in-house lab. The FKM grade and cure system are set here, against your medium.
Mould design and CNC tool manufacture, in-house, held as a controlled record. The lip profile sets the sealing force.
Moulding and metal bonding — elastomer moulded and bonded to the case in one operation. Rubber-to-metal bonding in-house (client-confirmed). Pending the complete-seal CONFIRM.

Post-cure — FKM is oven post-cured to complete crosslinking and drive off cure by-products. Without it the compound does not reach its published temperature or compression-set performance. The step that makes the +250 °C real.
Quality inspection — lip concentricity, bore and width to DIN 3760, plus hardness and batch sampling.
Export packaging — industrial packing with documentation. Seals packed to protect the lip. ISPM-15 treated pallets where timber is used.
fields.note:
Six steps, six kept.
Step 04 is the one that matters on an FKM page. Post-curing is a real, non-obvious, cost-bearing step, and a supplier who skips it ships FKM that does not perform as FKM — which is a genuine failure mode in this trade. Naming it is both a technical credential and a quiet competitive point.
Step 01 gains the grade decision, which is where it actually happens

notes: The process block must render from the part record.
